purpose: Independent test fixture. This is not the Agent business pipeline. Use synthetic requests and isolated local services only.

python.execution: Pass inlineCode to python -B -X utf8 -c; supply the listed environment variables. Do not save or run a temporary .py file. -B keeps the read-only Agent tree free of bytecode writes.
python.inlineCode:
import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.environ["KNODE_AGENT_SOURCE"])
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from opentelemetry import trace
from yan_agent.observability.tracing import configure_tracing, instrument_fastapi
import uvicorn

app = FastAPI()
configure_tracing(
    service_name="knode-python-fixture", service_version="1",
    otlp_endpoint=os.environ["KNODE_FIXTURE_OTLP"], sample_ratio=1.0,
)
instrument_fastapi(app)

@app.get("/fixture/python")
def fixture(request: Request):
    trace.get_current_span().set_attribute("knode.request_id", request.headers.get("x-request-id", ""))
    return {"message": "python-ok"}

uvicorn.run(app, host="127.0.0.1", port=int(os.environ["KNODE_FIXTURE_PORT"]), access_log=False)
python.dependencies: Use the existing yan-agent observability dependencies in its pyproject, or install FastAPI, uvicorn, SQLAlchemy and OpenTelemetry API/SDK/OTLP HTTP and FastAPI/SQLAlchemy instrumentation into an isolated target directory.

java.classpath: knode-observability/target/test-classes + target/classes + test dependency classpath generated by Maven dependency:build-classpath
java.environment: Set KNODE_OBSERVABILITY_ENABLED=true, KNODE_ENVIRONMENT=fixture, KNODE_SERVICE_VERSION=1, KNODE_TRACE_SAMPLE_RATIO=1 and KNODE_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:4318/v1/traces. Select dedicated application and loopback management ports.

gateway.routing: Set knode.gateway.content-uri to the Java fixture loopback address. Use GET /api/blog/article/obs/<synthetic-id>; GET /api/blog/article/obs-event exercises an in-process synthetic queue.
gateway.expect: Trace has Gateway server/client, Java server/client and Python server spans. Event consumer span uses the Java producer span as parent. Prometheus can scrape the independent loopback management ports.

limits: Fixture generates no real account, credential, user record, Redis event or external model request; it does not validate user Outbox, Stream delivery or Agent workflows.
